factoryName.metadata: Nombre de instancia de Data Factory

scriptLines: gender = case(lower(trim(gender)) == 'm' || lower(trim(gender)) == 'male', 'M', lower(trim(gender)) == 'f' || lower(trim(gender)) == 'female', 'F', upper(trim(gender))),

date_of_birth = coalesce(   toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MMMM dd, yyyy', 'en-US'),   toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MMM dd, yyyy', 'en-US'),   toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),   toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MM-dd-yy'),   toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),   toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'dd/MM/yyyy') )) ~> ConversionTipos

admission_date = coalesce(toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy', 'en-US'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM-dd-yy'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'dd/MM/yyyy'), toDate('1900-01-01')),

discharge_date = coalesce(toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy', 'en-US'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM-dd-yy'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd/MM/yyyy'))) ~> ConversionTipos

payment_date = coalesce(toDate(trim(payment_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy', 'en-US'), toDate(trim(payment_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(trim(payment_date), 'MM-dd-yy'), toDate(trim(payment_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(trim(payment_date), 'dd/MM/yyyy'))) ~> ConversionTipos
query: 'SELECT DISTINCT\n    ISNULL(department, \'GENERAL\') AS nombre_departamento\nFROM silver.admissions',

query: 'SELECT
    icd_code AS codigo_icd,
    MAX(diagnosis_description) AS descripcion_patologia,
    ISNULL(MAX(severity), 'NO ESPECIFICADA') AS nivel_severidad
FROM silver.diagnoses
WHERE icd_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY icd_code',

query: 'SELECT DISTINCT
    ISNULL(charge_type, 'OTROS') AS tipo_cargo,
    ISNULL(payment_status, 'PENDIENTE') AS estado_pago
FROM silver.billing',

query: 'SELECT DISTINCT
    patient_id AS patient_id_bk,
    ISNULL(full_name, 'SIN NOMBRE') AS nombre_completo,
    ISNULL(gender, 'NO ESPECIFICADO') AS genero,
    date_of_birth AS fecha_nacimiento,
    CASE
        WHEN date_of_birth IS NULL THEN 'DESCONOCIDO'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE()) < 18 THEN 'MENOR (<18)'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE()) BETWEEN 18 AND 35 THEN 'JOVEN (18-35)'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE()) BETWEEN 36 AND 60 THEN 'ADULTO (36-60)'
        ELSE 'ADULTO MAYOR (>60)'
    END AS rango_etario,
    email AS correo_electronico,
    address AS direccion,
    ISNULL(insurance_provider, 'SIN SEGURO') AS proveedor_seguro
FROM silver.patients',

query: 'SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), fecha, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_key,
    fecha AS fecha_completa,
    CAST(YEAR(fecha) AS INT) AS anio,
    CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, fecha) AS INT) AS trimestre,
    CONCAT('T', DATEPART(QUARTER, fecha)) AS trimestre_nombre,
    CAST(MONTH(fecha) AS INT) AS mes,
    DATENAME(MONTH, fecha) AS mes_nombre,
    CAST(LEFT(DATENAME(MONTH, fecha), 3) AS VARCHAR(3)) AS mes_corto,
    CAST(DATEPART(WEEK, fecha) AS INT) AS semana_anio,
    CAST(DAY(fecha) AS INT) AS dia_mes,
    CAST(DATEPART(WEEKDAY, fecha) AS INT) AS dia_semana,
    DATENAME(WEEKDAY, fecha) AS dia_nombre,
    CASE WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, fecha) IN (1, 7) THEN CAST(1 AS BIT) ELSE CAST(0 AS BIT) END AS es_fin_de_semana
FROM (
    SELECT admission_date AS fecha FROM silver.admissions WHERE admission_date IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT discharge_date AS fecha FROM silver.admissions WHERE discharge_date IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT payment_date AS fecha FROM silver.billing WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL
) AS f
WHERE CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), fecha, 112) AS INT) <> 19000101',

query: 'SELECT
    a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    a.patient_id,
    ISNULL(a.department, 'GENERAL') AS department,
    a.admission_date,
    a.discharge_date,
    ISNULL(a.attending_doctor_id, 0) AS medico_id,
    CASE WHEN a.discharge_date IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date) ELSE NULL END AS dias_estancia,
    1 AS conteo_admisiones,
    d.icd_code
FROM silver.admissions a
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT admission_id, MIN(icd_code) AS icd_code
    FROM silver.diagnoses
    GROUP BY admission_id
) d ON a.admission_id = d.admission_id',

query: 'SELECT
    b.billing_id AS billing_id_bk,
    b.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    a.patient_id,
    ISNULL(a.department, 'GENERAL') AS department,
    ISNULL(b.charge_type, 'OTROS') AS charge_type,
    ISNULL(b.payment_status, 'PENDIENTE') AS payment_status,
    b.payment_date,
    ISNULL(b.amount, 0.00) AS monto_facturado,
    1 AS conteo_transacciones
FROM silver.billing b
LEFT JOIN silver.admissions a ON b.admission_id = a.admission_id',
